name: Scenario 2: GitHub Connect Modal Regression Fixture

mockData.isolationGuarantee: Local offline mock only. No remote GitHub API requests, no OAuth redirects, no token transmission or credential access.

panelPaddingOverride.defect: Form declares Tailwind utility class 'p-6' expecting 1.5rem (24px) padding. In compiled CSS, .p-6 is layered in @layer utilities, while reset.css declares unlayered * { padding: 0 }. Under CSS Cascade Level 5 normal declaration rules, unlayered declarations outrank layered declarations regardless of selector specificity. Effective padding collapses to 0px.
panelPaddingOverride.targetLayer: @layer base for reset, allowing @layer utilities to win

buttonBackgroundAndPaddingOverride.defect: Buttons declare utility classes 'py-2.5 px-4 bg-zinc-900 text-white' (and .bg-zinc-100). In compiled CSS, utilities are layered in @layer utilities, while reset.css declares unlayered button { background: none; border: 0 }. The unlayered declaration overrides background-color to none/transparent and strips padding to 0px.

checkboxExpansion.defect: forms.css applies unlayered input, select { height: 2.75rem; padding-inline: var(--space-4); } (16px left + 16px right = 32px padding) to all input elements. The checkbox input[type="checkbox"] declares width: 1.1rem (~17.6px) but does not clear horizontal padding. With border-box sizing, the element cannot shrink below padding (32px) + borders (2px) = 34px-36px width, creating an oversized, distorted control.
